zh: 伦敦大学皇后玛丽学院（Queen Mary University of London，简称 QMUL）成立于1887年，是伦敦大学联盟的重要成员之一。学校位于伦敦东区，由多所历史悠久的学院合并而成，包括玛丽学院（1885年）、威斯特菲尔德学院（1882年）等。QMUL以其在医学、法学、经济学、计算机科学、工程学等领域的教学和研究而著称，是英国顶尖的研究型大学之一。
en: Queen Mary University of London (QMUL) was founded in 1887 and is an important member of the University of London federation. Located in East London

contact: the university was formed through the merger of several historic institutions

address.zh: including Queen Mary College (1885) and Westfield College (1882). QMUL is renowned for its teaching and research in medicine
